name: localeaf
description: Browser extension that compiles Overleaf projects locally (TeX Live in WebAssembly) and shows the result in Overleaf's own preview.

scripts.test:all: npm run -s typecheck && npm run -s build:test && npm run -s test:unit && npm run -s test:engine && npm run -s test:e2e && npm run -s test:e2e:history-ot && npm run -s test:e2e:stop && npm run -s test:e2e:any-site && npm run -s test:e2e:ui && npm run -s test:e2e:extremes && npm run -s test:e2e:fixtures
